title: Although he knew
goal: Say that something happened although something else was true, with -DIğI hâlde.

intro.text: The object participle with its possessive, then *hâlde*, means **although**: *Bildiği hâlde söylemedi* (Although he knew, he didn't say). It states a fact, often with surprise or reproach: *Söz verdiğin hâlde gelmedin*.

vocab.en: right; fairness (hak vermek: to agree that someone is right)
to turn out to be right

exercises.question: *Bildiği hâlde söylemedi.* What do we learn?
options: He knew, but he didn't say.
He didn't know, so he didn't say.
If he had known, he would have said.
exercises.explain: `-DIğI hâlde` is **although**: the fact (he knew) and what he did (he didn't say) go against each other.

exercises.en: Although you'd promised, you didn't come.

accept: verdiğin

reject.why: *Verdiğim* means **I** promised. The one who promised is **you**: *verdiğin*.
Before *hâlde*, the verb takes the participle `-DIk` and a possessive: *verdiğin hâlde*.

exercises.hint: The participle `-DIk`, then the possessive for **you**.

exercises.label: *çalışmamak* + *hâlde*: although I didn't study, although you didn't…

accept: çalışmadığım hâlde
çalışmadığın hâlde
çalışmadığı hâlde
çalışmadığımız hâlde
çalışmadığınız hâlde
çalışmadıkları hâlde

exercises.explain: Negative `-mA`, then `-DIk` (*-dığ-* before a vowel) and the possessive: *çalış-ma-dığ-ım hâlde*; for **they**, *çalışmadıkları*.

exercises.prompt: Although she was ill, she went to work.
accept: Hasta olduğu hâlde işe gitti.
Hasta olmasına rağmen işe gitti.
O hasta olduğu hâlde işe gitti.
[O|Onun] hasta olmasına rağmen işe gitti.

reject.why: *Olduğu için* is **because**: because she was ill, she went to work. **Although** is *olduğu hâlde*.

exercises.explain: An adjective goes through *olmak*: *hasta ol-duğ-u hâlde*.

accept: I went, although my mother did not want me to.
Although my [mother|mom] did not want me to, I went.
I went, although my mom did not want me to.
[Even though|Although] my [mother|mom] did not want it, I went.
I went even though my [mother|mom] did not want [me to|it].
I went, although my [mother|mom] did not want it.
Even though my [mother|mom] did not want me to, I went.

exercises.en: Although he didn't study at all, he passed the exam.

exercises.prompt: Haklı olduğum hâlde kimse bana hak vermedi.
exercises.text: Although I was right, nobody agreed with me.
accept: Nobody agreed with me, although I was right.

exercises.question: Choose the best ending: *Bu filmi üç kez izlediğim hâlde…*

why.1: Knowing it well is what you'd expect after three times: there's no contrast.
why.2: *Çünkü* gives a reason, but `-DIğI hâlde` needs something that goes against the fact.

exercises.explain: **Although I've seen this film three times, I still don't understand the ending.**

exercises.prompt: Although we were right, we couldn't convince them.
accept: Haklı olduğumuz hâlde onları ikna edemedik.
Haklı olmamıza rağmen onları ikna edemedik.
Biz haklı olduğumuz hâlde onları ikna edemedik.
[Biz|Bizim] haklı olmamıza rağmen onları ikna edemedik.
exercises.explain: *haklı ol-duğ-umuz hâlde*: **although we were right**. *İkna edemedik*: we couldn't convince.
Before the consonant of *-leri*, the participle stays *-dik*; front vowels throughout: *bildikleri hâlde*.

exercises.en: Although you'd promised, you didn't come.

exercises.prompt: Vaktim olmadığı hâlde sana yardım ettim.
accept: Although I did not have time, I helped you.
I helped you, [although|even though] I [did not have|had no] time.
Even though I [did not have|had no] time, I helped you.
Although I had no time, I helped you.

exercises.question: Which sentence states a fact rather than imagining one?

why.1: *Yağsa bile* imagines rain: **even if it rains**.

exercises.explain: *Yağdığı hâlde*: it **was** raining, and we went anyway.
